name: Lyric Motion
author: moshi
description: Smooth motion for word-synced lyrics: each word floats up as it is sung and its letters grow a touch as the highlight reaches them; held words grow more, glow, and settle gently. Persian, Arabic and Hebrew lyrics are laid out right to left.

settings.label: Motion strength
settings.description: How far words float and grow, and how much held words grow and glow.

settings.label: Letter by letter
settings.description: A word lights up and grows one letter at a time, with the highlight. Off: each word moves in one piece.

settings.label: Held word starts at (ms)
settings.description: A word sung at least this long counts as held: it grows more and glows. Lower = more words get the held-word treatment.

settings.label: Glow
settings.description: Soft light behind a held word's letters; stronger the longer the word is held.

settings.label: Right-to-left lyrics
settings.description: Persian, Arabic, Hebrew and other right-to-left lyrics are detected automatically: words run from the right, lines sit against the right edge, and each word fills in from the right.

settings.label: Also animate the lyrics side panel
